description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for Claims to property of intestate in Hirikuluwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510210 and to 14 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and locations. The content focuses on property registration and title settlement processes for deceased persons' estates, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
